title: Rotate/confirm-dead the two DigitalOcean tokens in pushed history (zshrc-dorian, commit 233658f)
description: gitleaks generic-api-key findings baselined in .gitleaksignore. History can't be cleaned without a rewrite; the values must be revoked if they were ever live. Likely inherited from the dkarter fork.

title: Decide zsh formatting: shfmt corrupts zsh, so dprint no longer formats .zsh
description: Proven: shfmt -ln zsh rewrites ${widgets[complete-word]} to ${widgets[complete - word]} in scripts/profile-completion.zsh. .zsh removed from the dprint exec shfmt exts. Options: leave unformatted, or find a zsh-safe formatter.

title: Remove or wire committed.toml (commit-msg hook uses cog)
description: lefthook commit-msg runs cog verify; committed.toml is unused config left from upstream.
